title: FCC Authorizes 1 Million Satellites for Data Centers in Space

quotes.text: Today, the Federal Communications Commission granted the first authorization in U.S. history for a constellation of data centers in space.
quotes.for: The FCC's description of the Starmind authorization as the first U.S. approval for an orbital data center constellation.

quotes.text: This action opens a bold new frontier for the computing infrastructure needed to power America’s leadership and growth.
quotes.for: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr's statement on the authorization.
